hook: Nobody noticed when the tea got expensive.

beats.text: Two years ago this glass cost you ten rupees.
Today the same glass costs twenty.
That is one hundred percent, in twenty four months.
And not one person at the stall said anything about it.

cta: Check your own chai. Then check what else moved.
title: The tea price nobody argued about
caption: Ten to twenty in two years. Nobody blinked.
